$comment: Windy Mind OPS surface — FIRST Class-C retrofit (the cloud template). Deliberately named ops.mcp.v1, NOT control: the inference API (/v1/chat) is the product and stays out of this contract (ADR-060 §2 Class C: the ops shim is separate from the product API). Every tool here is a real route on https://api.windymind.ai, bound via transport (Gen-1 escape hatch). Rev 2026-07-13 (gap-closing pass 1): get_logs + get_config + run_selftest SHIPPED — the /ops/* trio requires an authenticated caller (EPT or Pro JWT; the woven shim forwards the remote caller's own EPT, Mind's wall is the single authority). get_logs is content-free BY CONSTRUCTION (fixed event vocabulary; provider errors categorized, never stored raw — error bodies can embed prompts). run_selftest makes ONE real minimal inference through the broker's free-biased chain (paid fallbacks disallowed) and caches its verdict 60s so polling can't burn quota; its payload uses `passed`, never top-level `ok` (reserved by the invoke envelope). STILL-OPEN gaps (docs/handoffs/MIND-LANE punch list): set_setting (runtime provider-key change without redeploy) and apply_update (SSH-free health-gated redeploy, ops plane OUTSIDE the patient) — the mutating pair, next pass. DEPLOY STATUS: merged; live after the Grant-gated image rebuild — probe before trusting mid-incident.

get_config.note: effective runtime config, secrets redacted to booleans — closed 2026-07-13.

reconnect.note: stateless HTTP service — no standing connection to re-establish (providers are probed per-call).

restart_app.note: out-of-band (compose restart); belongs with apply_update's out-of-patient hook.

set_setting.note: runtime provider-key / routing change WITHOUT redeploy; always_confirm + OWNER band. Next pass.

check_for_update.note: resolve /version against the Steamroller's /v1/fleet-versions (live on admin).

apply_update.note: §7 URGENT: SSH-free health-gated redeploy, attested + last-known-good rollback; the hook lives OUTSIDE the api container it restarts. Next pass.

reset_to_defaults.note: config is env + DB-backed keys; a factory reset has no meaning for a stateless broker.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: The FIRST call when anything seems wrong with Windy Mind. Liveness check on the cloud brain-broker: returns ok + service + version if the API process is up and answering.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read Windy Mind's deployment identity: which build is actually serving right now (service name, package version, commit sha). Use this to tell whether a fix that was supposed to deploy is really live.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Report which AI provider adapters are actually usable right now — per provider, whether its key is configured. This is the tri-state capability probe: when a user's model requests fail, check here first to see if the provider is even wired up.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every AI model Windy Mind can broker right now, with per-model metadata. Use this when a user says 'my model is gone' or asks what brains are on the buffet.

tools.name: explain_route
tools.description: Ask Windy Mind which provider it would route a given model request to, and why — without actually calling the model. Use this to diagnose 'why did my request go to the wrong/expensive provider' complaints.

model.description: The model id to explain routing for, e.g. claude-sonnet-5.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Read Windy Mind's recent operational events — server starts, per-provider failures by category (quota exhausted, bad key, timeout, empty completion), and self-test results. Content-free by construction: the log can only ever hold fixed event names and category codes, never a prompt, completion, or raw provider error. Requires an authenticated caller (your passport or account token).

entries.description: [{ts, level, event, code?}] — fixed vocabulary only

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Read Windy Mind's effective runtime configuration with every secret redacted to a boolean: which provider adapters actually hold keys, whether the database / Redis / telemetry legs are wired, and which environment this deployment thinks it is. Use this when 'the buffet shrank' — it shows the gap between what's advertised and what's actually configured. Requires an authenticated caller.

providers.description: {provider: configured bool} — never key material, not even fingerprints

tools.name: run_selftest
tools.description: Actively exercise Windy Mind's real core path: one minimal chat call routed through the broker exactly the way a user's request would be, but riding only the free-biased chain (paid fallbacks disallowed — the canary never spends money). Reports pass/fail per stage (config, then inference) with which model and provider answered and how fast — never the reply text. The verdict is cached for 60 seconds, so polling it cannot burn provider quota. Requires an authenticated caller.

model.description: Optional model id to canary; default = the broker's free-biased default chain.

passed.description: true only when every stage passed ('passed', not 'ok' — top-level ok is reserved for the invoke envelope)

stages.description: [{name: config|inference, ok, detail}] — detail is model/provider/latency, never completion text
